routing: Recognize the captured strict local next/last token before GetActiveDevices. Consume the recognized action on all local outcomes and route it through native metadata loading, existing-owner insertion, or first-Watch startup. Recognized failures never delegate to the original discovery request.
presentation: Capture the native playlist panel update and capture Watch responses again after controller initialization; snapshot only native queue items into the existing engagement panel.
local_edits: Owned RVPortQueue section move/remove callbacks invoke native queue methods, avoiding remote playlist edits.
preservation: Unknown MDX shapes, active casting queues and unrelated playlist/video responses retain original behavior. No account entitlement value is changed.
live_baseline: Authenticated installed .68 source fingerprint matched delivery. First queue tap failed native_queue_unavailable; after a video was loaded, two actions produced two confirmed native mutations, native queue count three, two native panel refreshes and no blocker.
observed_limit: Installed .71 showed activation state 2 with no player and no Watch response until tapping the miniplayer. After close, a fresh owner and successful metadata request again timed out at native_watch_bootstrap_timeout. The .72 implementation has not been observed on device.
source_identity: Prefer the exact original MDX token video ID and next/last enum. Metadata must match that target.
metadata: Copy matching native metadata rows or use dedicated Player service. Build the proto with that service native YTPlayerRequestFactory, including active client/account context. Require matching videoId and present client context before sending. Record construction failures and native error code/type. Suppress response actions only for metadata instance; require title and thumbnail for insertion.
startup: Immediate native collapsed playback: beginPlaybackOnMinibar false, prefersPlaybackLayoutStateCollapsed true, pausePlaybackWhenVideoActivates false. Native branch acquires the player and handles any inline-player release. Pending seeding still waits for a matching Watch response and coherent owner.
lifecycle: Watch clear/dismiss invalidates adapter presentation, ownership and metadata generations. Native startup handoff preserves pending bootstrap; actual minibar dismissal cancels it. Owner replacement invalidates cached presentation and metadata; account changes cancel bootstrap too. Explicit native queue clear cancels metadata but retains the active Watch response for reseeding.
current_video: Read contentVideoID from the coherent WatchPlaybackController; reject Watch-layer candidates that are not its currentWatchController. Feed/inline player globals do not establish the current Watch video.
